title: BEST INFINITE CREEPER & IRON FARM 1.21! Minecraft Tutorial In 60s!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of creeper iron farm farming inspired by the Gnembon module. It uses 2 combined multi-type farms which makes it possible to farm 2 types while afking in one farm, and this makes it a perfect and great choice since the iron golems won't affect mob caps and you will end up farming 2 farms at once in Minecraft!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
